statement: For each integer n ≥ 4, there is a finite number Dnat(n) > 0 with the following property. Let (Mn, g) be a connected complete smooth Riemannian manifold without boundary, and let D ≥ Dnat(n). Choose a maximal D-separated set of centers (xi)i∈I, where I = {1, . . . , N} or I = N, and put Ai = Bg(xi, D), Bi = M \ Bg(xi, 2D). Suppose every Bi is nonempty. Choose positive numbers p∗ i for i ∈ {0} ∪ I such that X i∈{0}∪I p∗ i = 1 20 . Assume there are a complete smooth metric h ≥ g and a finite or countable family of smooth real functions (pα) with locally finite compact supports such that disth(Ai, Bi) > 10 + 2π q 2/p∗ i (i ∈ I), R(h, (pα)) ≥ 2 5 on M. (2.2) 4 Then there is a continuous map f : M → K to a simplicial complex of dimension at most n − 2, with its usual polyhedral topology, such that sup y∈K diamg f−1 (y) ≤ 4D + 2. The diameter bounds the entire fiber, including all its components.
